# Staff Outing Schedule: York and the Dales (2 days, 1 night)

Tour period: Saturday 21 November 2026 – Sunday 22 November 2026

Group: 32 people (led by Emma Hughes, Office Services)

Meeting point: King's Cross station, Platform 0 entrance

## Day 1: Saturday 21 November 2026

| Time | Programme |
| --- | --- |
| 06:40 | Meet at King's Cross station, Platform 0 entrance |
| 07:00 | Train to York (departs London 07:00, arrives York 09:05) |
| 09:30 | Coach from York station to the Minster (about 15 minutes) |
| 10:00 | Guided tour of York Minster |
| 12:30 | Lunch in the Shambles |
| 14:00 | National Railway Museum |
| 17:30 | Arrive at the Dalesview Hotel |
| 19:00 | Dinner |

## Day 2: Sunday 22 November 2026

| Time | Programme |
| --- | --- |
| 08:30 | Leave the hotel |
| 09:30 | Walk at Malham Cove |
| 12:00 | Lunch in Skipton |
| 13:30 | Coach from Skipton to York station (about 75 minutes) |
| 15:30 | Train to London (departs York 15:30, arrives London 17:35) |
| 17:35 | Group disbands at King's Cross station, Platform 0 entrance |
